title: タイキとパールと外国語

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While at the cafeteria, I spot Taiki Shuttle and Seeking the Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If I'm going to rule the world one day, I'll need to master English, French—all the languages!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll be! Lookin' to become multilingual, are ya?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes! A maestro of fluency!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But even if mastering those languages ends up being too rough, you'd be surprised how well you can get by with plain ol' body language!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Interesting… I suppose that even if our words are different, we still express our feelings the same way! The world sure is bursting with possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Taiki! Shall we test this out by having a conversation using only body language and the word "revolution"?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's engage in a passionate exchange while expressing our emotions with our bodies! And one word!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Woo! Now that's a daisy idea right there! Okay, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Revolution?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ahh! Revolution!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Reeevolution! Revolution!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hehe, revolution. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although they look like they're thoroughly enjoying their "conversation," I haven't the slightest inkling of what it's about…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, couldn't you infer the meaning from our body language and intonation?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I started the conversation by asking, "Which do you prefer, the northern or southern hemisphere?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: She said, "The northern hemisphere," and I'm of the same opinion, so I replied, "What a coincidence! That's where I plan to begin my global conquest."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll be! I thought you were inviting me to a shindig at your homestead, and I was mighty keen on it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You told me you had yourself a hankering for some good grub, so I said, "I'll rustle you up some barbecue! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like I wasn't the only one who struggled to follow the conversation…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It appears that branching out into the world isn't all that simple.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yep, well, I reckon you're asking for a sticky time by sticking to body language.
choice_data_list: How about changing the word you use?
Maybe words aren't necessary at all.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I figure you're right! Next up, let's try it with "muffin"!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Muffin!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Muuuffin!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Muffin! Muffin!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Muffiiin?
choice_data_list: What were you talking about this time?
What were you talking about this time?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: First, I declared, "I'm going to rule the world!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I thought so! 'Cause that's when I said, "And no mistake!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Then I responded by saying, "Thank you! Be sure to come to the celebration party!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Then, I said, "I wonder what kinda duds I ought to put on for that!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew! We did it! We understood each other perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Indeed! I'm now another step closer to world domination!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That settles it! Muffins are understood the world over! Thank you for the suggestion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although the logic behind their conversation is murky at best, I get the sense they've stumbled onto an idea with great potential.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Unnecessary? You're saying to stick to plain ol' body language?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I understand now—our half-baked word choice ended up transforming our conversation into mere noise!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's so clear now! The global stage demands a bold approach! Let's begin our body language exchange!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okay! Hmph… Hmph…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hah… Mmph…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wow! Awesome! Ha! Ho!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Excellent! I can feel your passion! How's this?! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure it constitutes a conversation, but the two energetically exchange thoughts while making use of their entire bodies.
